preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, with 1 ≤ T ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(N.is_integer() and N > 0 and N <= 10**9 for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each N is a positive integer representing the maximum length of palindromes, with 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(count_palindromes(N) % 1000000007) for N in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]]) + '\n'
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the count of palindromes of length ≤ N modulo 1000000007, where count_palindromes(N) is the total number of palindromes of length 1 to N.
